title: Beat 4 played slump, rise and threshold for 36 frames, the ruled holds are 26, 20 and 24
text:
Animatic 04 played beat 4 from the six D99 keys and the hold-band check refused it: 'hold of 36 frames at 630-665, 740-775 and 840-875 is over 27 and no key declares it' (quoted in v3/studies/animatic-04.md; the first render's frames are kept as out/animatic-fig-seq-04a and out/animatic-seq-04a). The first drawing of each move landed 10 frames after the ruled hold ended, so the viewer saw slump, rise and threshold for 36 frames, not 26, 20 and 24.

Done 2026-10-19, the hold wins. In v3/poses/s02-the-frame.json (breakdown frames only; the keys, their solved joints and the joints of every kept drawing are unchanged, so every keysHash and the plates stand) each move's first drawing now lands on the frame its key's hold ends: 656, 706, 760, 814 and 864. The exposure sheet (v3/xsheet.json) holds slump, turn, rise, step, threshold and through for exactly 26, 16, 20, 14, 24 and 30 frames.

The 4-frame spacing could not be kept on any of the five moves. They run 34, 34, 40, 26 and 36 frames from the end of a hold to the next key; six drawings of at most 4 frames cover 24, and the hold-band check (C28) calls a drawing held 5 to 10 frames a hold under 11. So each move opens with one hold-length drawing, the coil, held 16, 14, 20, 12 and 16 frames (the anticipation, and for turn -> rise a new anticipation at -0.10 because a first drawing 26 % along the chord failed the joints-only ease check); the rest of the move is drawn on fours, its last drawing 2 to 4 frames before the next key. To keep the arcs and the cloak's response inside their checks: turn -> rise lost its 0.74 passing; step -> threshold lost its 0.26 and 0.40 passings for one 0.30 passing on 826 (the heel tap stays on 828 and its settle on 836); slump -> turn ends on 688, two frames before the turn key (a layout ending on 686 read the cloak settling 20 frames after a step against 14 declared).

Cost: five more holds and five more pops (a held drawing against a key's hold with no drawing between): the animatic's hold-band lists 34 holds and 15 pops against 29 and 10, and the pose gate's per-shot form, which runs hold-band with --no-pops, would refuse the five. Open for the owner: the coil is the check's only door. A 34-frame move could instead run 8 drawings (C28 allows 3 to 6), or draw on sixes (the check calls a 6-frame drawing a hold under 11); either changes the rubric, not this sheet.

Row 9.5, 2026-10-19: the wide restage (D101) leaves the holds as they were. On the restaged animatic (`out/animatic-05-draft-seq`, `out/animatic-05-draft-fig-seq`) `probe-holds.py` reads `pass: hold-band - 34 holds in the band or declared, 12 moves of 3-6 drawings, 15 pops, 7 intentional long holds listed` (the same 34, 12 and 15 as above) and `probe-twos.py` `pass: twos-ones - the drawing changed on 85 even frames and 0 odd frames`. Beat 4's figure is now drawn as the parts rig (the garment change of sp-4.3 needs it) and the poncho leaves on frame 760, the frame the rise hold ends and the first drawing of the rise -> step move lands, so the change falls on a drawing the exposure sheet has a row for. The coil question above is untouched and still open.
before: slump, rise and threshold on screen 36 frames (ruled 26, 20, 24); hold-band FAIL on those three holds; 29 holds, 10 pops
after: every key on screen exactly its D99 frames (26, 16, 20, 14, 24, 30); hold-band pass (34 holds, 12 moves of 3-6 drawings, 15 pops); probe-all --contract pass; followthrough pass on the shot's and the animatic's joints; five moves open with a held drawing of 12 to 20 frames; held at 34 holds, 12 moves, 15 pops after the wide restage (row 9.5)
